label: AMP
full_name: AMP: Authentication of Media via Provenance
inventors: England, Malvar, Horvitz, Jenks, Kane, Wenker et al.
description: Foundational system for certifying media provenance via signed manifests, permissioned ledger (CCF), and manifest database. Introduced: provenance manifest, assertion graph, authenticity signal UI, consortium governance.

label: MIA
full_name: MIA: Media Integrity & Authentication
inventors: Jenks, England, Wenker, Burke-Aguero, Sharma et al.
description: Internal Microsoft initiative combining cryptographic file integrity, fragile watermarking, and provenance ledger. Precursor to AMP and C2PA. Introduced: tamper-evident media chain, media integrity assertion.

label: US11917084
full_name: Cryptographic Validation of Media Integrity
description: File-level cryptographic hash integrity box inside media container; X.509 certs; per-sample signing for deepfake detection. MIA core integrity assertion. PCT filed as WO2021076382A1.

label: US12244875
full_name: Provenance of Media Content During Live Streaming
inventors: Jenks, Wenker, Kane, England, Lin, Simmons, Burns
description: Ephemeral live-stream key pair signed by long-term key; provenance manifest in bitstream; hierarchical temporal granularity (chunk/fragment/segment). Published app: US20240314367A1. C2PA v2.3 live video provenance directly implements this.

label: US20250175655
full_name: Live Streaming Provenance (Continuation)
inventors: Jenks, Wenker, Kane, England, Lin, Simmons, Burns
description: Continuation of US12244875; broadened claims for provenance manifest and live-stream key hierarchy.

label: US12086898
full_name: Media Provenance Certification via Fragile Watermarking
description: Fragile watermark keyed to provenance server; destroyed by significant alteration; enables retroactive provenance verification for existing media without prior manifest registration.

label: US20240403992
full_name: Fragile Watermarking Provenance (Continuation)
description: Continuation of US12086898; broadened claims. Soft binding language adopted in C2PA v2.x spec.

label: US20100153227
full_name: Mobile Phone Billing for Content Payment
description: Methods for using mobile phone accounts as a payment mechanism for purchasing digital content. Addresses monetization of content on mobile devices when app stores and carrier billing were nascent. Streamlines carrier/content-provider/consumer relationships. Earliest Jenks Microsoft patent — established content-distribution thinking that informed later provenance work.

label: US11093586
full_name: Presenting Content Protected by Multiple DRMs
description: Enables a client device configured for DRM-1 to present content protected by DRM-2; brokers license acquisition challenges across heterogeneous DRM environments. Granted US11093586B2 (2021). Core multi-DRM interoperability architecture — distinctive cross-DRM license brokering vocabulary adopted widely in OTT space.

label: US20240265071
full_name: VDI Security via Video & Input Pipelines
description: Security techniques leveraging video rendering and user input pipelines of VDI environments. Secured video pipeline + secured input pipeline resist data leaks even when edge device is compromised. PCT: WO2024167720A1; EP: EP4662578A1. Family 5 in Jenks 5-family portfolio.

label: US20230052755
full_name: Cryptographic Validation of Media Integrity (Pub. App.)
description: Published application of US11917084 — creates prior art record for media integrity assertions cited by subsequent examiners.

label: WO2024191670
full_name: PCT: Live Streaming Provenance
description: PCT international filing of US12244875; extends live-streaming provenance manifest claims globally across IP5 offices.

label: EP4681437
full_name: EP: Live Streaming Provenance
description: European regional phase of WO2024191670; live-streaming provenance manifest in broadcast context.

label: Truepic US10956767
full_name: Controlled Media Capture and Authentication System
description: Hardware-anchored photo/video auth at point-of-capture; provenance metadata cryptographically bound to sensor data. Parallel to MIA capture-time approach; Truepic is C2PA steering member.

label: Adobe US11250513
full_name: Content Attribution and Authenticity for Digital Images
description: Foundational Adobe CAI patent: content credentials binding, provenance assertions, edit history watermarking. Co-filed with C2PA formation; uses AMP assertion-graph architecture.

label: WO2021076382
full_name: PCT: Cryptographic Validation of Media Integrity
description: PCT international filing of US11917084 (filed 2020); establishes global prior art for cryptographic media integrity validation. Citable in EP/JP/KR/CN prosecution. Part of Family 3 in Jenks' 5-patent-family portfolio.

label: Intertrust US12164502
full_name: Digital Content Integrity Verification Systems
description: Blockchain/immutable ledger of content assertions; trusted entity assertions — mirrors AMP assertion-graph and tamper-evident media chain terminology without formal citation.

label: Content Auth Mobile
full_name: Content Authenticity Mobile Device & Method
description: Tamper-evident visual digital signature at mobile capture; verification via embedded content credentials; directly reuses AMP/MIA terminology for point-of-capture authenticity.

label: Google SynthID Pat.
full_name: Identifying Synthetic Media Using Digital Watermarking
description: AI-generated content watermarking for authenticity; reuses AMP authenticity signal and provenance language in AI context. Foundation of SynthID product.

label: Sony Prov. Camera
full_name: Imaging Device with Provenance Certification
description: Camera-embedded provenance manifest signing; C2PA-aligned hardware. Reuses provenance manifest and tamper-evident metadata chain terminology.

label: BBC Origin Ledger
full_name: Media Provenance Ledger and Auth. Infrastructure
description: Multi-stakeholder provenance management system; authenticity signal broadcast metadata. Key Project Origin IP — co-developed with AMP at Microsoft.

label: Qualcomm Cam Prov.
full_name: Camera-Based Content Provenance and Authenticity
description: Chipset-level provenance manifest generation; C2PA-conformant capture credentials at SoC level.

label: OpenAI Prov. Pat.
full_name: AI-Generated Content Provenance Labeling System
description: C2PA-conformant content credentials for DALL-E/GPT-4o outputs; provenance assertion binding for synthetic media.

label: Leica Prov. Camera
full_name: Digital Camera with Content Authenticity System
description: First commercial camera with C2PA content credentials; provenance manifest in RAW/JPEG.

label: C2PA Spec v1.0
full_name: C2PA Content Credentials Specification v1.0
description: First open standard for content provenance; defines C2PA Manifest, Assertion, Claim, Claim Generator, trust hierarchy. Codifies AMP manifest and assertion-graph concepts into normative spec.

label: C2PA Spec v2.3
full_name: C2PA Content Credentials Specification v2.3
description: Feb 2026 release; adds live video provenance, plain text docs, OGG audio, cloud-sourced manifests, stronger tamper detection. Live video provenance directly implements US12244875.

label: W3C Verif. Creds
full_name: W3C Verifiable Credentials Data Model v2.0
description: W3C VC used in C2PA trust model for actor identity assertions. AMP consortium governance influenced W3C media provenance community group.

label: ISO 19566-5 JUMBF
full_name: ISO 19566-5: JPEG Universal Metadata Box Format
description: Container format used by C2PA to embed Manifest Stores in JPEG, MP4, WAV, PDF. Codifies tamper-evident metadata chain concept originated in MIA/AMP.

label: Project Origin
full_name: Project Origin Alliance
description: Multi-stakeholder news authenticity initiative co-developing AMP; contributed multi-stakeholder provenance management to C2PA formation.

label: Adobe Firefly CC
full_name: Adobe Firefly / Photoshop — Content Credentials
description: First major creative suite embedding C2PA Content Credentials. Implements full provenance assertion graph: AI generation flags, editing history, capture chain. 500M+ image exports.

label: MS Designer/Bing
full_name: Microsoft Designer / Bing Image Creator
description: Microsoft consumer AI image tools embed C2PA credentials in all outputs. Direct productization of AMP/MIA research — same team, same provenance manifest architecture.

label: OpenAI DALL-E CC
full_name: OpenAI DALL-E — C2PA Content Credentials
description: DALL-E 3 and ChatGPT image outputs carry C2PA credentials flagging AI generation. Extends AMP provenance chain to synthetic media at scale.

label: Google SynthID
full_name: Google DeepMind SynthID
description: Invisible watermarking for AI-generated images, text, audio, video. Parallels AMP fragile watermarking; Google joined C2PA 2024 aligning SynthID with open provenance standards.

label: Sony Alpha C2PA
full_name: Sony Alpha Cameras — C2PA Hardware Provenance
description: Sony Alpha cameras sign content credentials at shutter. Hardware implementation of capture-time provenance manifest; uses ephemeral session key model from US12244875.

label: Truepic Platform
full_name: Truepic Controlled Capture Platform
description: Commercial platform for hardware-anchored media authentication. Early implementer of provenance manifest at capture; C2PA steering committee member.

label: Instagram CC
full_name: Meta Instagram — Content Credentials
description: Instagram labels AI-generated images using C2PA Content Credentials. AMP's consumer-facing provenance indicator UX deployed at 2B+ user scale.

label: Leica M11-P
full_name: Leica M11-P — First C2PA Camera
description: World's first camera with built-in Content Credentials (Oct 2023). Signs provenance manifest at capture using hardware key — direct implementation of live-stream manifest key architecture.

label: BBC Verify
full_name: BBC Verify — Provenance-Anchored Journalism
description: BBC's content verification unit using provenance metadata and C2PA manifests to authenticate news footage. Operational realization of Project Origin / AMP.

label: CAI Browser Plugin
full_name: Content Authenticity Initiative — Browser Extension
description: Browser plugin displaying Content Credentials inline — direct realization of AMP's original 'browser icon' provenance indicator UX concept from the 2021 paper.

label: WO2024167720
full_name: PCT: VDI Security via Video & Input Pipelines
inventors: Jenks, Wenker, Srour, Laslo, Gupta, Makhervaks
description: PCT international filing of US20240265071A1; extends secured VDI video/input pipeline claims globally. Establishes prior art for cryptographic element-based VDI session protection across IP5 offices.

label: EP4662578
full_name: EP: VDI Security via Video & Input Pipelines
inventors: Jenks, Wenker, Srour, Laslo, Gupta, Makhervaks
description: European regional phase of WO2024167720A1; secured VDI video/input pipeline protection in European cloud and enterprise contexts.

label: Irdeto Multi-DRM
full_name: Multi-DRM Key Management and Content Protection Brokering
description: Multi-DRM key server architecture for OTT delivery; brokers decryption keys across Widevine, PlayReady, and FairPlay simultaneously. Reuses cross-DRM license brokering and heterogeneous DRM environment terminology from Jenks US11093586B2 without formal citation.

label: Synamedia Cross-DRM
full_name: Cross-DRM License Management for OTT Streaming
description: Unified license acquisition across heterogeneous DRM systems for OTT operators; DRM interoperability layer and cross-DRM policy enforcement. Closely mirrors Jenks multi-DRM forwarding and state-information vocabulary; cites PlayReady/Widevine cross-system challenge patterns.

label: Apple Multi-CDM
full_name: Multi-CDM Content Decryption and DRM Interoperability
description: Content Decryption Module (CDM) abstraction layer enabling FairPlay to interoperate with external DRM license acquisition flows; heterogeneous DRM environment bridging on Apple platforms. Terminology overlaps directly with Jenks DRM-1/DRM-2 bridge architecture.

label: Citrix Secure Display
full_name: Secure Display Pipeline for Virtual Applications
description: Cryptographically secured video rendering pipeline for Citrix Virtual Apps; prevents screen-scraping and display interception at the virtual display layer. Reuses secured video pipeline, display interception, and VDI session protection terminology parallel to Jenks US20240265071A1.

label: VMware Input Protection
full_name: Virtualized Input Device Security and Data Exfiltration Prevention
description: Encrypted input pipeline for VMware Horizon VDI; intercepts and encrypts keystrokes and pointing-device input at the virtualized input layer before OS exposure. Directly parallels Jenks input pipeline protection concept; reuses data exfiltration, compromised edge device, and encrypted input channel terminology.

label: NVIDIA Secure Video
full_name: GPU-Based Secure Video Pipeline and Display Protection
description: Hardware GPU-enforced secure video pipeline for cloud gaming and VDI; cryptographic element in GPU protects video stream from host OS inspection. Reuses secured video pipeline, cryptographic element, and display interception prevention vocabulary from Jenks VDI patent family.

label: IBM US11856109
full_name: Entity Certificate Management for Media Integrity
description: Certificate issuance and lifecycle management for entity identity assertions in media provenance chains. Directly cites US11917084B2 (Jenks et al.) for the X.509 / media-integrity-box architecture. Applies it to enterprise-scale entity cert rotation.

label: IBM US11683185
full_name: Entity Certificate Management — Key Rotation Variant
description: Key-rotation companion to US11856109; cites US11917084B2 for cryptographic media integrity assertion framework. Covers automated certificate refresh in media pipelines without re-signing content.

label: Qualcomm WO2023212838
full_name: Fast Signature Generation for Media Provenance
description: Hardware-accelerated signature generation for real-time media provenance at SoC level. Cites US11917084B2 for per-sample signing approach; extends it with parallel-signing pipelines in modem/camera SoC. Enables sub-frame provenance latency at chipset level.

label: CTM WO2024243113
full_name: Detecting False or Synthesized Media via Provenance Ledger
description: Provenance-ledger approach to deepfake and synthetic media detection. Cites US11917084B2 directly for cryptographic integrity assertion architecture; extends the tamper-evident chain concept to AI-generated video detection at platform scale.

label: NVIDIA US12386944
full_name: Staggered Authentication for Data Transfer
description: Staggered multi-phase authentication for high-bandwidth data streams; cites US12244875B2 for the live-stream key-hierarchy and per-chunk signing model. Adapts provenance-claim-per-portion to GPU-accelerated streaming pipelines in cloud gaming and VDI contexts — conceptual overlap with Jenks VDI patent family.

label: Fraunhofer EP4734532
full_name: Handling of Verification Chains in Authentication of Data Streams
description: Verification-chain management for authenticated data streams in broadcast/streaming contexts. Directly cites US12244875B2 for hierarchical temporal provenance claim architecture. European counterpart adds multi-party attestation chain for news and sports broadcast use cases.

label: US12368907
full_name: Attesting the Veracity of Audiovisual Depictions
description: System for attesting the veracity (truthfulness) of audiovisual depictions; provenance-manifest-like assertion structure; tamper-evident chain from capture through distribution. Appears as Google Patents similar document to US12244875 — strong terminology and concept reuse.

label: CN115640612
full_name: Media File Integrity Verification via Hash Chain
description: Hash-chain integrity verification for media files; architecture closely parallels Jenks US11917084B2 file-integrity-box approach for per-sample hash validation. Published shortly after WO2021076382A1 PCT was examined internationally.

label: Samsung Prov. Cam.
full_name: Imaging Device with Content Authenticity Certification
description: Camera and mobile device provenance manifest generation at capture; C2PA-conformant content credentials signed by hardware TEE. Reuses provenance manifest, tamper-evident media chain, and capture-time authenticity metadata vocabulary aligned with Jenks US12244875.

label: Nikon Prov. Camera
full_name: Digital Camera Content Authenticity and Provenance Signing
description: Nikon Z-series camera C2PA content credentials signing at capture; hardware security module generates provenance manifest; implements ephemeral session key model from Jenks live-streaming patent for timelapse/video contexts.

label: Anthropic AI Prov.
full_name: Provenance Attestation for AI-Generated Content
description: Content provenance assertion system for Claude/AI outputs; cryptographic binding of generation parameters, model version, and user consent to provenance manifest. Reuses assertion graph and authenticity signal vocabulary from AMP/C2PA. Parallel to OpenAI DALL-E C2PA approach.

label: Witness.org Prov.
full_name: Human Rights Media Provenance and Authenticity Chain
description: Provenance chain for human rights documentation media; tamper-evident chain from field capture through evidentiary use; content authenticity signal for court-admissible media. Implements AMP/C2PA provenance manifest architecture for conflict-zone journalism.

label: MPEG AI Content ID
full_name: ISO/IEC MPEG AI-Generated Content Identification (WG11)
description: MPEG working group developing international standard for identifying and labeling AI-generated audio-visual content; heavily references C2PA provenance manifest model and AMP assertion-graph architecture as foundational prior art.

label: YouTube Auth. Label
full_name: YouTube — Content Authenticity Initiative Labels
description: YouTube AI-generated content disclosure labels using C2PA-conformant provenance signals; Google joined C2PA in 2024. At 2B+ users, the largest single deployment of content authenticity signal UX — the exact 'browser icon' concept prototyped in AMP.

label: Nikon Z9 C2PA
full_name: Nikon Z9 / Zf — First Nikon C2PA Camera
description: Nikon cameras shipping with built-in C2PA content credentials (2024); provenance manifest signed at shutter using NCP (Nikon Content Protocol). Hardware implementation of capture-time provenance; joins Leica and Sony in photojournalism C2PA ecosystem.

label: TikTok AI Labels
full_name: TikTok — AI-Generated Content Labels and C2PA
description: TikTok AI-generated content labeling system reading C2PA Content Credentials; displays provenance indicator UX (same 'authenticity signal' concept from AMP 2021 paper). Deployed to 1B+ users. Parallel to Instagram/Meta C2PA implementation.
